title: Approvals
description: Per-user approval state for machine-health remediations and check overrides. Lives at $OutputBase/state/approvals.json. Not checked into source control. Edited directly by the user or by migration on first run.

remediations.description: Keyed by remediation id as declared in references/<os>/remediation-policy.md.

approved.description: True enables the remediation on non-dry-run runs.

approved_by.description: Free-form identifier for audit (hostname, username, or note).

check_overrides.description: Per-check user-curated state that augments shipped defaults. Optional.

noise_allowlist.description: User-added benign-event entries for event-log-errors. Merged with the shipped allowlist.

service_exclusions.description: Service names excluded from Restart-StoppedService remediation (per-host).

migration.description: Populated on first migration from TODO.md. Removed in next major version.
